static_release_note: Public timetable release/version metadata and calendar validity are not real service-outcome exposure. A static release date alone is not an evaluated service date.

rule_review.selection: Exclude all58 dates above. Keep the chronological14-date, public12-root-per-date structural recipe and expanded menu fixed before target labels. Inspect existing source/capture metadata only for availability; no success-based date replacement.
rule_review.residual_gap: A complete registered root where a predeclared feasible challenger beats each of the six separately fixed cheap policies is a candidate mechanism. Preserve every negative, tie and unknown case; do not deploy a hindsight per-root baseline or call a realized positive an expected-value result.
rule_review.budget_and_information: Original128 worlds/120 process-CPU seconds, fixed repaired likelihood/V41 operator, common external stream and local observation contract. No outcome-driven budget extension or refit.
rule_review.stop: No residual mechanism or theoretical novelty does not support deeper reconstruction. An incomplete source panel is data unavailability, not evidence that no decision gap exists. Independent calibration keeps its separate frozen14-day gate.

limits: The ledger records documented exposure; it does not prove that every unlisted date is pristine or source-complete.
